propositions: Per-client bearer PATs must be materialized on-box from SSM at deploy time into a 0600 rsync-excluded `.env` file as `MCP_CLIENT_PAT_*` environment variables, never baked into the rsync'd source tree or committed.
The `mcp-static-tokens.json` file read by the `static` verifier must reference materialized PATs via `token_env` property names only, never containing plaintext tokens or raw PAT values.

A repo-root local-only client-credential config template `mcp-clients.local.example.json` must be committed as a placeholder, with the real file `mcp-clients.local.json` gitignored and never committed.

The `static` verifier loads its token set once at `__init__` and does not re-read per-request; credential rotation requires restarting/replacing the `rebar-mcp` process, not merely rewriting the tokens file.

Both `mcp-static-tokens.json` and `/mcp-clients.local.json` must be added to `.gitignore` and excluded from rsync in `autodeploy.sh` to prevent value-only rotation from being clobbered by source sync.
A guard test must verify that no real PAT pattern is committed and that `git check-ignore` matches the gitignored credential paths.
